tasks.question: List the first name, last name, and email of every customer whose country is Canada.
tasks.sqlp: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email FROM Customer c WHERE c.Country = 'Canada';
tasks.sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email FROM Customer c WHERE c.Country = 'Canada';

tasks.question: List album titles by the artist AC/DC, once per album.
tasks.sqlp: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a WHERE a.artist.Name = 'AC/DC';
tasks.sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Artist r ON a.ArtistId = r.ArtistId WHERE r.Name = 'AC/DC';

tasks.question: List the track name and album title of each Iron Maiden track.
tasks.sqlp: SELECT t.Name, t.album.Title FROM Track t WHERE t.album.artist.Name = 'Iron Maiden';
tasks.sql: SELECT t.Name, a.Title FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId JOIN Artist r ON a.ArtistId = r.ArtistId WHERE r.Name = 'Iron Maiden';

tasks.question: For every invoice to a customer living in France, list its invoice ID and the customer first name and country.
tasks.sqlp: SELECT i.InvoiceId, i.customer.FirstName, i.customer.Country FROM Invoice i WHERE i.customer.Country = 'France';
tasks.sql: SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.FirstName, c.Country FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'France';

tasks.question: List each Brazilian customer first name together with the first name of their assigned support representative.
tasks.sqlp: SELECT c.FirstName, c.supportRep.FirstName FROM Customer c WHERE c.Country = 'Brazil';
tasks.sql: SELECT c.FirstName, e.FirstName FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId WHERE c.Country = 'Brazil';

tasks.question: Which customer email addresses bought at least one track by Queen? Return each email once.
tasks.sqlp: SELECT DISTINCT l.invoice.customer.Email FROM InvoiceLine l WHERE l.track.album.artist.Name = 'Queen';
tasks.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.Email FROM InvoiceLine l JOIN Invoice i ON l.InvoiceId=i.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId JOIN Track t ON l.TrackId=t.TrackId JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId=a.AlbumId JOIN Artist r ON a.ArtistId=r.ArtistId WHERE r.Name='Queen';

tasks.question: List the track name for every Jazz purchase line. Keep a repeated name when the track was purchased more than once.
tasks.sqlp: SELECT l.track.Name FROM InvoiceLine l WHERE l.track.genre.Name = 'Jazz';
tasks.sql: SELECT t.Name FROM InvoiceLine l JOIN Track t ON l.TrackId=t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId=g.GenreId WHERE g.Name='Jazz';

tasks.question: List each distinct album-title and artist-name pair that has a Classical track.
tasks.sqlp: SELECT DISTINCT t.album.Title, t.album.artist.Name FROM Track t WHERE t.genre.Name = 'Classical';
tasks.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.Title, r.Name FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId=g.GenreId JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId=a.AlbumId JOIN Artist r ON a.ArtistId=r.ArtistId WHERE g.Name='Classical';

tasks.question: List invoice IDs billed to the USA whose customer is supported by Jane Peacock.
tasks.sqlp: SELECT i.InvoiceId FROM Invoice i WHERE i.BillingCountry = 'USA' AND i.customer.supportRep.FirstName = 'Jane' AND i.customer.supportRep.LastName = 'Peacock';
tasks.sql: SELECT i.InvoiceId FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId=e.EmployeeId WHERE i.BillingCountry='USA' AND e.FirstName='Jane' AND e.LastName='Peacock';

tasks.question: For each purchase line of a track from album ID 1, list the invoice ID, track name, and quantity.
tasks.sqlp: SELECT l.InvoiceId, l.track.Name, l.Quantity FROM InvoiceLine l WHERE l.track.album.AlbumId = 1;
tasks.sql: SELECT l.InvoiceId, t.Name, l.Quantity FROM InvoiceLine l JOIN Track t ON l.TrackId=t.TrackId JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId=a.AlbumId WHERE a.AlbumId=1;

tasks.question: List email addresses of customers living in the USA whose assigned support representative also lives in the USA.

tasks.sql: SELECT c.Email FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId=e.EmployeeId WHERE c.Country='USA' AND e.Country='USA';

tasks.question: List the track name and duration in milliseconds for Jazz tracks stored as MPEG audio file.
